title: The Second Wind flyer · every size
note: The flyer we made, adapted to feed 4:5, story 9:16, square 1:1 and landscape 16:9 — and on three of the new light fields.

title: Lineup · compositions
note: The same night in eight compositions (A–H) and backgrounds. Black label blocks by default, Lime as an option.

title: Posters · one composition per reference
note: Every image in the ME Refs folder became a named composition (the reference number is in the builder). Same building blocks underneath: colourway, wrapping, type, shapes, background effect. Text adapts: one name or twenty.

title: Posters · stories, squares, landscape
note: The compositions keep their idea at every size; the text boxes refit.

title: How the text is wrapped
note: One composition, nine ways to hold the words: block, tight (no padding), glow, spectrum stripe, halftone dots, soft focus, outline, band to the edge, no block.

title: Colourways
note: Twelve colour combinations of the four brand colours (plus THE MAZE orange): field, text, label block, accent.

title: Background lab · photo effects
note: The background creator: any photo, GIF or video through a gradient map, duotone, posterize, halftone, dot matrix, dither, ASCII, glyphs, pixel, scan lines or thermal. Upload yours in the builder.

title: Shapes · vector layers
note: Layers that sit between the background and the type. Mix as many as you like in the builder.

title: Type · 403 Quzie
note: THE MAZE's typeface opens up to every poster: Regular, Condensed and Wide, set against ABC Normal.

title: Animated posts
note: The type builds once, holds, and clears on a 10 s loop: blur in, rise, wipe, type, flicker, drift. Effect backgrounds can move too (ASCII flicker, dither crawl). MP4 for each.

title: THE MAZE · its own flyer
note: Built from the real MAZE flyers: maze blocks over a blurred, gradient-mapped photo with heavy grain, the MAZE logo in its block, 403 Quzie names, IN ORDER OF APPEARANCE, the venue. Five palettes, every size; try another maze pattern in the builder.

title: Set times · tours · menus · mix covers
note: New post types: the timetable (rows, faces, big times), a series of dates, the bar menu, covers for mixes and playlists.

title: Carousel · case study
note: Eight slides for a recap or a case: cover, text, image, numbers, quote, list, image, end card. Swipe order left to right.

title: Carousel · journal article
note: The same slides as an article in squares, with colourways per slide.

title: Just announced
note: Real press photos. The ME on top, the venue logo at the bottom, and all the info: night, date, time, place.

title: Ticket giveaway
note: Photo window, full photo (centred, words low), ticket stub — on photos, solids and effect backgrounds.

title: Ticket messaging
note: Presale live, tickets live, on sale now, final release, last tickets, sold out. Seven compositions: low, centred, top, left, band (full width or hugging), one line full width. The button can be switched off; the message can be one block per word or one line.

title: Monthly calendar
note: One month of nights in one post, five ways: rows, big dates, label blocks, a month grid, photo + rows.

title: Now hiring
note: Five ways to say it: an object in a framed grid (walkie-talkie, flight case, headphones, crew pass, gaffer tape), a statement on a photo, the open roles, a big headline, a crew pass. Text on the left means the logo on the left.

title: Statements
note: Type-led posts on every kind of background: loops, shaders, solids, photo effects. Five compositions: low, centred, top, quote, split photo. The ME takes the colour that reads, never boxed.

title: Colour fields · bloom · new gradient maps
note: Photos blurred to pure colour (colour field), lit from inside (bloom), and eight new gradient maps from the brand and MAZE colours: chrome silver, lilac light, lime light, midnight blue, MAZE ice, MAZE lime, ember glow, infrared.

title: Textures
note: A texture over the background, under the type: dust, film grain, toner, film burn, paper, scan lines, halftone dots, noise. One click in the builder.

title: THE MAZE · on loops and photos
note: Pick any background loop or photo and it becomes the MAZE field, mapped to the palette (a loop keeps moving). Story and landscape covers keep the logo clear of the type.

title: Shader loops · shapes
note: The WebGL loops now light simple shapes (ring, pill, rings, blob) instead of a big logo, so the flyer's own logo stays the only one.

title: Light fields · from the references
note: New WebGL loops drawn from the ME reference posters, light and texture only: anamorphic prism streaks (FUSE), a zoom-blur vortex (Four Tet), colour fog (Rüfüs), pixel-sorted glitch and film grain. Every one loops seamlessly.

title: Prism blues
note: A family of deep blues: light through a prism with spectral edges, a blue streak, vortex, fog, glitch and grain. Lime and ice type sit on all of them.

title: Textures · ten more
note: Photocopy, riso grain, line screen, CRT, VHS, grid, paper folds, scratches, stipple and canvas. On a dark post the darkening ones turn to light specks so they still show.

title: THE MAZE field · on any flyer
note: The MAZE blocks and blurred colour field as a background for every template, in the five MAZE palettes.

title: Just announced · on any background
note: The artist photo full bleed, through an effect, or framed over a loop, a colour or the MAZE field.
